subject: Important Update Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in processing your recent purchase due to high demand. Rest assured, we are working diligently to fulfill your order as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, The Customer Service Team
